name: Corne / Left
description: A documented Corne keyboard study: original enclosure STEP, source plate contours and exact PCB footprint relationships. Ask a part how it works, then explore a constrained wireless conversion.
provenance: Corne by foostan, source commit 63366fb7f51cf2a796462fdd90527e99dd126055, CC BY 4.0 / MIT. Enclosure STEP is original geometry; plate apertures and PCB-relative placements come from published files. Source plate pattern registration RMS 0.0072 mm. Source parts are rigidly registered to the case USB opening for this study; assembly tolerance has not been physically verified. PCB silhouette, keycaps, switch internals, chip bodies, cable and optional acoustic insert are reconstructed/illustrative and labeled per part. No electrical conversion or hardware performance is verified.
